name: zha-device-handlers-atomic-tuya-thermostat-6a4e
instr:
ZHA Device Handlers cannot atomically write Tuya thermostat attributes with stable, unique transaction results confirmed by device reports. Implement this for Moes BHT, HY08WE, and ZONNSMART thermostats without changing ordinary writes or discovery.

Plan and validate each request for its concrete family before transport or cache updates become observable. Reject every unsupported standardized attribute, including in empty or mixed requests. Preserve every requested value and its order. Keep coupled manufacturer writes adjacent, indivisible, and identical in transport progress.

Moes BHT confirmation requires both inverse programming reports. HY08WE must retain attribute-specific temperature scales and distinct manual, scheduled, and economy meanings. ZONNSMART must keep stopping, schedule, manual, holiday, and frost-protection meanings separate.

Only attempted writes can be confirmed from reports, and each standardized intention can be confirmed once. Failure or cancellation stops later transport and accurately returns completed, failed, and unattempted progress. Retries receive new identifiers and cannot consume delayed reports from earlier work.

Transaction-status metadata must accept only compatible server thermostat clusters, expose the selected cluster's latest result and lifecycle updates, resolve the thermostat producing the result, and expose exactly one later confirmation update. Leave ordinary entity identities and discovery unchanged. Ordinary `write_attributes`
